name: field-onboarding-assignment
objective: إنشاء أو تمديد عقد onboarding assignment حقيقي بين قسم الشركاء والميداني بدل raw Actor ID/Workforce scope، مع provenance وصلاحية ضيقة وlifecycle كامل.
truthOwner: DSH owns onboarding assignment/business work; Workforce owns employee identity/status only.

tasks.objective: Build/reuse the authoritative onboarding-assignment lifecycle and its Control Panel/Field surfaces.
tasks.currentProblem: Current field assignment workspace relies on raw Actor ID/Workforce scope and does not model a merchant onboarding work item with business provenance.
tasks.requiredChange: Search existing DSH work-item semantics first; extend or create a dedicated assignment with operator picker, minimal lead hints, lifecycle, linked draft, audit and object authorization.
tasks.targetState: Partners operator selects a real field employee, enters store name plus phone or address/location, field receives task, opens it, starts a draft with editable canonical values, and original hints/audit remain immutable history.
tasks.action: Implement contract/domain/db/API/UI/tests across DSH and both surfaces; inventory all Partners/HR pages and tabs that read or mutate field assignment and remove obsolete raw-ID path once replacement is proven.
mustNotChange: لا إنشاء Store canonical عند assignment.
لا منح broad store scope من مجرد assignment.
لا نسخ employment status إلى DSH كمصدر مستقل.
acceptanceCriteria: operator يختار field actor بالاسم من Workforce authority.
assignment minimal data تعمل مع lifecycle كامل.
field لا يرى assignment لميداني آخر.
reassign/cancel/suspend تحفظ history وتمنع action غير صالح.
كل صفحات/تبويبات Partners/HR الميدانية تستخدم العقد الجديد دون raw Actor ID path متبقٍ.
tasks.rollback: Forward migration/feature rollback must preserve assignment/draft history; never restore raw-ID scope as business task.
tasks.commitBoundary: Assignment domain + required Control Panel/Field integration coherent batch.
